title: Chapter 862
paragraphs: Chapter 862
Episode 215. Reunion with God (3)
"What? She's asking to be saved?"
"Yes, Murakan. She's clearly saying that...ugh."
Yulian staggered, clutching her head. The sudden interaction with Payitel was straining her body.
"Kaltor, don't you hear any... Oh, this child has lost it."
"Ugh, gag."
Kaltor was the same. He was even more affected by the interaction with Payitel than Yulian was.
The group was lost in thought, as this was an unexpected situation.
"What on earth is happening? As soon as they arrive, they start to have a hurried interaction, asking for help. Is Payitel getting beaten by someone around here? But I don't feel any energy."
Even if it wasn't near Island No. 32, if there was a battle going on somewhere in the Blue Bird Archipelago that was pushing Payitel to a corner, the group wouldn't be unaware of it.
"Ugh."
"Gag, uh!"
Yulian and Kaltor's convulsions continued.
"Hey, you guys. Get it together. Huh?"
"Gag, Payi, Payitel, in, battle, ugh."
"What? Battle? No, where is she fighting?"
"Murakan, fly and scan the entire archipelago."
Murakan transformed into his true form and flew into the sky. However, no matter how hard he looked, he couldn't see anyone fighting.
[As expected, I can't see anything, kiddo.]
"There's no record of a battle in the Record Window either, Jin."
Jin soon came to a conclusion.
"Hmm, then it's one of two things. One is that Payitel just tried to interact through the remaining energy of Gram here. The battle is happening somewhere else. The second is a subspace."
Thwack, thwack!
Suddenly, Murakan landed on the ground and slapped Yulian and Kaltor's backs.
"Cough!"
"Ugh!"
"Murakan, what?"
"I seemed to snap out of it a bit when you did this to me whenever I lost it."
"Yulian and Kaltor are not as strong as you. Especially Kaltor, he's just recovered and is in a weak state, how could such a method work...?"
"Ugh, cough."
Although their faces turned pale, Yulian and Kaltor regained consciousness and looked at their colleagues.
"It's a subspace, Lord Jin. The tomb of the Thunder God Gram... Lady Payitel is in battle there!"

Yulian exclaimed. During their interaction with Payitel, she and Kaltor were able to receive the situation Payitel was in. Until now, Payitel had been hiding in Gram's tomb, in other words, in the subspace. Why she was hiding was something they had to find out.
"How do we get in?"
"Right now, Lady Payitel is struggling to open the entrance, but it seems difficult. But, when Lord Murakan hit me and the interaction was about to be cut off, suddenly she was looking for Lord Jin."
"Me?"
"Yes, Lord Jin, you hold the weapon that serves as the key to the tomb..."
"It seems like a very critical situation, she must have thought of the possibility that you have become our alliance member."
"It seems so."
Sigmund's sword was still shining with the mark of Gram.
"How did she say I should use my sword?"
"In a moment, Lady Payitel will attempt to communicate with Lord Jin and explain."
Just as she said, Jin was soon able to hear Payitel's voice.
[Hey, hey! Jin Runkandel...! Can you hear my voice!?]

The rest of the group was the same. Payitel's voice was not ringing in Jin's mind or inside him, but emanating from the spirit of Sigmund's sword. The mark of Payitel had appeared on the sword's spirit along with the mark of Gram.
[Hey, can you hear me? Quickly answer!]
Payitel's urgent voice continued. Jin grinned.
It was a very familiar situation.
A situation where he could wrest something from someone in a hurry. It didn't matter if the other party was a god.
"I can hear you. But who said you could dwell in Sigmund without my permission? Are you impersonating that energy just because you're Gram's sibling? It's annoying, anyway."
Jin responded with a deliberately belittling voice. Luna and Runtia inwardly shook their heads at the sight of their youngest's malicious behavior after a long time.
[Help me!]
"Why should I? I don't have many good memories with you."
[Yu, isn't Yulian your subordinate!?]
"I would say she's more like a colleague since you're too inconsiderate to be a subordinate. But what?"
"Then you should help me, if I disappear here, Yulian will fall into being a human without any special abilities!"
"What if I don't want to?"
[Please! I'm saying that I could really disappear right now!]

"No, no. That's not how you ask for a favor. If you really want my help, swear right here as a god, betting everything. After you survive with my help, promise to devote anything for the Barmel Alliance."
That was the original purpose why Jin's group came to find Payitel. They wanted to find a clue for the liberation project of the Golden Fleet and Lafra Rosa through this unfortunate god's powers.
Knowing well about Payitel's nature, they gathered members on the assumption of violence and threats from the beginning. It was the perfect situation to get a promise from Payitel.
[I will, I promise!]

"Empty promises are meaningless. Show me a means of absolute trust, like Shinu's Seal of Fire. Then we will help you with all our might. By the way, we have Murakan who has mostly regained his power from his prime, three knights close to the First Sword of Humanity including me, and also a wizard of Hysterga."
[Aaah! I can't use that kind of supreme power like Shinu!]
"Then there's nothing we can do. We'll leave, so try to survive on your own."
Just when Jin was about to leave his seat and draw his sword, they saw letters appearing over Sigmund's blade.
<I, Payitel, swear to keep the promise with Jin Runkandel.>
It was the Seal of the Storm. Like the Seal of Fire, the sentence held absolute trust, though it was definitely of lower quality than Shinu's seal.

"Wow, this guy. Trying to deceive us even in such a hurry. But the little one is usually not an ordinary guy. It would've been better if you came out like this from the start. Without worrying about saving face."
"Your request has been received, O Storm God. How can we assist you?"
[Now! I will open the door through the sword, quickly come into the tomb!]
"Yes, we are ready. Please open it soon."
As soon as Jin answered, a blue thunderbolt poured from Sigmund. It was the thunderbolt of Payitel and Gram, with a slightly different color than that of the Demon King's energy.
The thunderbolt soon opened a circular dimensional gate. Beyond the gate was a landscape filled with storms and thunder and lightning.
As soon as they entered, they were able to see Payitel, who had a human-like form, and the unidentified powerhouses pressuring her.
'Are there five in total? I've never seen them before, but they feel familiar somehow.'
Jin positioned himself in front of Payitel and examined the enemies.
Payitel looked like she had been cornered until just now. She was full of wounds and her breath was ragged, while all the enemies were in perfect condition.
[...What is this situation?]
[Payitel, you called for reinforcements.]
[Is that, Jin Runkandel? And his Guardian Dragon Murakan and... White Whale, seems like Runtia. I never heard that Payitel had connections with Runkandel.]
The enemies recognized Jin and his companions at a glance. Jin continued to wonder why they felt strangely familiar. Luna and Runtyia felt the same way.
'Ah, could it be?'
-You seem to have had a fight somewhere. You smell just like a young dragon named Pye. The smell of blood and ashes, the smell of war. I worry whether your realm, the Land of Fire, has been invaded.
-[Haha, how surprising.]
-No matter how much you try to hide it with the majesty of a god, it's no use. You look like a patient who is seriously injured in my eyes.
-[Yes, you see it correctly. I'm on my way back from dealing with the guys who just violated my territory.]
The conversation Shino had with Tikkan when she was deified.
At that time, Shino referred to the violators of her territory as 'priests of the Sun God religion'.
-[The priests of the Sun God religion are mostly made up of the dead, heroes who were once highly esteemed.]
-Revived old strong men, how tiresome.
-[They're all people who died harboring resentment or obsession. They became priests because they were fascinated by the words that they could get what they wanted if the Sun God resurrected.]
Jin realized why the unfamiliar enemies seemed familiar.
They were all legendary figures he had read about in history books.

"King Kaiman Yuron, Mad Dog Trax Cungen, Kurano's Wall Luzin Typoon, Governor Chin Mayer, Fighting God Tuzad Attila...... I'm surprised to meet you seniors. Nice to meet you, I'm Jin Runckandel, the family head of Runckandel."
Yuron, Cungen, Typoon, Mayer, Attila. All five of these clans had indirect relations with most of Jin's companions.
They were all clans that had been extinguished by the Runckandel in the past. Their inscriptions were still left in the Fortress of Storms.
[We're not glad to see each other. After all, your ancestors killed us.]

"It's regrettable, but isn't that the way of the warrior world? But among the others, senior from Cungen family should not dare to look me in the eye right now. It was a result of you guys invading the Fortress of Storms 200 years ago and killing the children of Runckandel."

Trax Cungen was the head of the Cungen clan at the time, and he was the mastermind behind the Fortress of Storms assassination 200 years ago. Trax revealed his murderous intent even in the face of Jin's words.

"I won't say much. We have to take Faitel with us, so seniors, please disappear right now. Whether it's Sanna's order or Beradin's order, if you go back and tell them you met me and my sisters, and Murakan, you'll probably hear that you backed down well."
At his words, Tuzad Attila pointed his sword at Jin. Among the priests of the Sun God religion here, he was the leading figure.
[You talk a lot, the Runckandels I've met weren't like this. Come on.]
Jin shrugged his shoulders and locked eyes with Tuzad.
"It was already uncomfortable to hear that your nickname is Fighting God. I only know one Fighting God, so I guess I'll have to show you what that means today."
